summary.business_type: Local service business (hybrid: workshop/office in Kundrathur + service-area across Chennai) — residential & commercial interiors
summary.audit_scope: Pre-launch: local production build (vite build + vite preview) of the single-page site. Intended domain mninterior.in did not resolve via DNS on 2026-11-27. Live-only checks (hosting headers, redirects, real-user CWV, GSC, backlinks, GBP/NAP citations) not run.
top_findings: Raw HTML is an empty JS shell (0 characters of text without JavaScript) — AI crawlers and link previews see nothing
No structured data at all (no LocalBusiness/HomeAndConstructionBusiness, FAQPage, Organization)
No robots.txt, sitemap.xml, canonical tag or favicon; missing files fall back to the homepage HTML (soft 404s)
Showcase photos appear to be AI-generated renders presented as 'Real projects' — trust/E-E-A-T and policy risk
3.9 MB of unoptimised JPEGs (~0.8 MB each) with no width/height, no WebP/AVIF, no og:image
quick_wins: Add LocalBusiness + FAQPage JSON-LD to index.html (static, no JS needed)
Add public/robots.txt, public/sitemap.xml, <link rel=canonical>, og:url, og:image, favicon
Compress showcase images to WebP ~1200px (~100-150 KB each) and add width/height
Delete/rewrite stale metadata.json ('Kalaigar Interiors', 22 years, 15-yr guarantee)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS-ready static build
lang=en set
viewport meta present
No horizontal scroll on mobile
Single clean URL, in-page anchors for sections

findings.title: Client-side-only rendering: empty HTML shell
findings.description: With JavaScript disabled the page body contains 0 characters; all 2,395 words, headings, NAP and FAQs are injected by a 504 KB React bundle. Google renders JS (deferred), but GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Bing's first pass, WhatsApp/Facebook link previews do not.
findings.recommendation: Pre-render the page at build time (e.g. vite-plugin-prerender / react-dom/server renderToString in a small build script, or move to Astro/Next static export) so dist/index.html ships the full HTML; hydrate on top.

findings.title: No robots.txt or sitemap.xml
findings.description: Neither file exists in public/. On the preview server /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml return 200 with the homepage HTML (SPA fallback) — crawlers get an invalid robots file and soft 404s.
findings.recommendation: Add public/robots.txt (Allow all + Sitemap: https://mninterior.in/sitemap.xml) and public/sitemap.xml listing https://mninterior.in/. Configure host to return real 404s for unknown paths.

findings.title: No canonical, og:url or www/apex decision
findings.description: No <link rel=canonical>. Hosting will likely serve both www and apex plus any Cloud Run *.run.app URL — duplicate hosts.
findings.recommendation: Add <link rel="canonical" href="https://mninterior.in/"> and og:url; 301 www→apex and block/redirect the *.run.app host.

findings.title: No favicon / apple-touch-icon
findings.description: No icon link; Google shows favicons next to mobile results.
findings.recommendation: Add a 48x48-multiple favicon (SVG + PNG) and apple-touch-icon.

findings.title: Images served from /src/assets path via copy plugin
findings.description: Images bypass Vite's asset pipeline (no hashing/compression), served from /src/assets/images/... with long timestamp filenames.
findings.recommendation: Import images or move to public/images with descriptive names (modular-kitchen-kundrathur-chennai.webp).

findings.title: Security headers unverified
findings.description: Cannot test HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options etc. until hosted.
findings.recommendation: Re-run audit against the live URL after launch.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: 2,395 words of specific, locally-relevant copy (Kundrathur, Kavanur, Porur, Anna Nagar, Chennai humidity/monsoons)
Concrete service details: plywood, soft-close, loft, pooja units
Real-looking Google review quotes with names
6 FAQs answering real buyer questions
Clear process (6 steps), warranty terms, address & hours

findings.title: Showcase images look AI-generated but are labelled 'Real projects'
findings.description: The five showcase images come from an image-generation pipeline (vite.config comment 'generate_image output', timestamped filenames) yet sit under 'REAL PROJECTS. HAPPY CLIENTS.' with specific localities (Porur, Anna Nagar). For an interiors business, portfolio authenticity is the core trust signal; misleading visuals hurt E-E-A-T and conversions and can conflict with Google's misrepresentation policies for ads/GBP.
findings.recommendation: Replace with real site photos (even phone photos) of completed jobs; until then label them 'Design concept' and remove locality claims.

findings.title: Thin authorship / Experience signals
findings.description: No founder/owner name, team photo, workshop photo, year established, GST/registration, or link to the Google Business Profile reviews page.
findings.recommendation: Add an About block: owner name + photo, founding year, workshop photo, GBP review link, social profiles.

findings.title: Stale conflicting metadata.json
findings.description: metadata.json says 'Kalaigar Interiors — since 2004, 22 years, Burma teak, 15-year guarantee' — contradicts site (MN Interiors, 20+ years, 10-year warranty). If served it is a contradictory entity signal.
findings.recommendation: Update or delete metadata.json (it is AI-Studio scaffolding).

findings.title: Unverifiable stat claims
findings.description: '100% within agreed budget', 'Rated 5 ★ for workmanship' on anonymised projects.
findings.recommendation: Tie each benchmark to a named review or real photo set.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Title 68 chars with brand + service + location
Meta description 150 chars, location + USP
Exactly one H1; logical H2/H3 hierarchy
Descriptive section IDs

findings.title: Single page targets every service and locality
findings.description: One URL tries to rank for modular kitchens, wardrobes, pooja rooms, TV units, shop interiors and 9 locality clusters. Competing Chennai interior sites rank with dedicated service and area pages.
findings.recommendation: Post-launch add /modular-kitchen-chennai, /wardrobes-chennai, /pooja-room-designs-chennai, /commercial-shop-interiors-chennai and 3-5 genuine area pages (Kundrathur, Porur, Tambaram...) with unique photos/projects.

findings.title: H1 and title missing the primary search phrase
findings.description: H1 is a slogan ('20+ years of Chennai interiors. Crafted to last every day.'). People search 'interior designers in Kundrathur', 'home interiors Chennai', 'modular kitchen Kundrathur'.
findings.recommendation: Title: 'MN Interiors | Interior Designers & Modular Kitchens in Kundrathur, Chennai'. Keep the slogan visually but add a keyword line inside the H1 or the pill above it.

findings.title: No navigation menu
findings.description: Header has no links (by design). Section anchors exist only further down.
findings.recommendation: Fine for a one-pager; once service pages exist, add a nav.

findings.title: No outbound authority links
findings.description: Only tel:, wa.me and a Google Maps search link. No link to the actual GBP listing or socials.
findings.recommendation: Link the real GBP place URL (from Share on Maps) and Instagram/Facebook/YouTube if they exist.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Content needed for schema (NAP, hours, FAQs, services) already exists in src/data/content.ts

findings.title: No JSON-LD at all
findings.description: Zero structured data blocks found after render.
findings.recommendation: Add static JSON-LD in index.html: HomeAndConstructionBusiness (name, address 600089, geo, telephone, openingHours, url, image, priceRange, areaServed Chennai, sameAs GBP/socials), WebSite, and FAQPage mirroring the 6 FAQs.

findings.title: Don't add self-serving AggregateRating
findings.description: Google ignores review stars a LocalBusiness puts on its own site, and marking up the 4.9/71 Google rating there can be treated as a policy violation.
findings.recommendation: Omit aggregateRating/review; let the GBP carry stars.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Desktop lab: FCP 0.28 s, LCP 0.64 s, CLS 0.0005
Mobile (4x CPU, ~1.6 Mbps, 150 ms RTT): FCP 1.42 s, LCP 1.85 s (text element), CLS 0.068
Images lazy-loaded
fonts display=swap with preconnect

findings.title: 504 KB JS bundle (149 KB gzip) gates all content
findings.description: Because the page is client-rendered, nothing paints until the full bundle downloads and executes. Vite warns the chunk exceeds 500 KB. Real-world Indian 4G + local server latency will push LCP higher than lab.
findings.recommendation: Pre-rendering fixes the critical path. Also split BookingModal/WorkShowcase via lazy(), and check phosphor icon imports tree-shake.

findings.title: Mobile CLS 0.068
findings.description: Under the 0.1 threshold but close; images lack width/height and fonts swap.
findings.recommendation: Add width/height (or aspect-ratio) to images; consider size-adjust fallback fonts.

findings.title: Unused heavy dependencies
findings.description: @google/genai, express, lucide-react, dotenv are in dependencies but not imported by src.
findings.recommendation: Remove from package.json.

findings.title: Field data unavailable
findings.description: No CrUX data pre-launch.
findings.recommendation: Check PageSpeed Insights / Search Console CWV 28 days after launch.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: FAQ answers are self-contained and quotable
Explicit facts: address, phone, hours, warranty, years, service area

findings.title: AI crawlers see an empty page
findings.description: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and most agent fetchers don't run JS — they would index only the <title> and meta description.
findings.recommendation: Pre-render (same fix as Technical).

findings.title: No entity corroboration
findings.description: No sameAs links, no Organization schema, no About/owner info for AI engines to resolve the entity 'MN Interiors Kundrathur'.
findings.recommendation: Schema with sameAs + consistent NAP on GBP, JustDial, Sulekha, IndiaMART, Houzz.

findings.title: No robots.txt AI policy / llms.txt
findings.description: Optional; llms.txt is not used by Google.
findings.recommendation: robots.txt allowing all is sufficient; llms.txt optional.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All 5 images have descriptive, keyword-relevant alt text
loading=lazy on all

findings.title: 3.9 MB of JPEGs
findings.description: Each showcase image is 680-836 KB at 1200-1376 px, displayed at 362-746 px.
findings.recommendation: Export WebP/AVIF at 800 and 1400 px with srcset; target <150 KB each.

findings.title: No og:image / social preview
findings.description: Links shared on WhatsApp (your main channel) show no preview image.
findings.recommendation: Add 1200x630 og:image + twitter:image (a real kitchen photo with logo).

findings.title: No width/height attributes
findings.description: Contributes to layout shift.
findings.recommendation: Add intrinsic width/height.

findings.title: Non-descriptive filenames
findings.description: mn_kitchen_showcase_1795762703455.jpg
findings.recommendation: modular-kitchen-kundrathur-chennai.webp etc.
